name: mongodb-atlas-mcp-server
title: MongoDB Atlas MCP Server
summary: MongoDB Atlas MCP Server is the cloud-hosted MongoDB Atlas MCP server. MCP clients connect over HTTP and authenticate with OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE.
description: MongoDB Atlas MCP Server is the Atlas-hosted remote MCP server. MCP-aware LLMs connect to the hosted endpoint at https://mcp.mongodb.com and authenticate using OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code flow with PKCE, so the server acts with the authorizing user's Atlas permissions. Static API keys are not supported on the remote HTTP endpoint.

mongodbOAuth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE for MongoDB Atlas.
